$comment: Source of truth for marketing/images/testimonials/. Photos of people, customers and events come only from the AhaSlides Drive photo library or Customer Love, never a stock photo, and every photo entry carries source "drive" or "customer-love" (standards.mjs fails otherwise). The avatar-quote-* files are real AhaSlides customers shown with their own quotes from ahaslides.com. Every entry lists its source URL, licence and fetch date. Refresh by re-fetching sourceUrl and re-cropping (avatars: square crop around the face, 128 px; webp quality 72-80).
